problem: A particle moves with a constant velocity of $u=-2i\,\text{km/h}.$ Find the speed of the particle.

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Speed of a Particle Given Its Velocity
examples.problem: A particle moves with a constant velocity of $\mathbf{u}=(5\mathbf{i} +2\mathbf{j}) \,\textrm{km/h}.$ Find the speed of the particle.
examples.worked_solution:
The speed of a particle equals the magnitude of its velocity.

Therefore, the speed of the particle is

$$
\begin{aligned}|u| & =|5i+2j| \\  & =\sqrt{{5}^{2}+{2}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{25+4} \\  & =\sqrt{29}\end{aligned}
$$

kilometers per hour.
